title: Ledger verification run-record
description: An auditable record of one local verification of a source ledger, written by verify_quotes.py --stamp to verified_claims/_runs/<key>.run.json. record_sha256 self-seals every other field; the three sha256 body/source/extract hashes let CI attest the committed stamp without the (git-ignored) corpus.

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the raw source bytes (local-only; not re-checkable in CI).

body_sha256.description: sha256 of the ledger's own quoted body — recomputable in CI from the committed ledger.

file.description: Path to the local source file.

transcript_sha256.description: sha256 of the verbatim verification transcript.

record_sha256.description: sha256 over all other fields — the self-seal.
